message.content:
The image is an editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO". The main subject is a cartoon man with pink skin, purple hair, and a round face. He wears pink and white headphones, a light blue long-sleeved shirt with two chest pockets, and yellow pants. He is depicted dancing with his eyes closed and a smile, pointing his fingers in opposite directions. Around him, various objects float against a background of radiating pink and teal stripes and stylized cream clouds. These floating objects include fried chicken legs, fried eggs, blue rectangular cafeteria trays with circular compartments, and four solid pink rectangular signs on sticks.

At the top, the large word "TEMPO" is written in white block letters. Above it, text reads "EDISI KHUSUS 1 TAHUN PEMERINTAHAN PRABOWO". Below the masthead, the title "KONSOLIDASI INDONESIA TERPIMPIN" is rendered in bold, red-and-white 3D block lettering. A yellow-and-orange circular sun-like shape sits behind the man. The bottom edge includes a barcode, a QR code, and text indicating the date "20-26 OKTOBER 2025" and the price "RP 60.000".
